caption: The drawing depicts three views of a butter churn and its plunger. The central object is a tall, cylindrical, tan-colored stoneware jar with two handles on each side and a fitted lid with a wooden plunger extending vertically upward. The jar features a decorative blue floral design on the front and has text printed in black above the decoration. In the upper left corner, there is a detailed depiction of the lid with the wooden plunger coming through its center, shown separately. In the lower right corner, a side view of the plunger and a portion of the churn are depicted. A small, linear scale appears in the lower left corner of the drawing. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Churn
